hook_text: 14 out of 40 learners walk to school. How big is their slice of pie? 126 degrees.
clip_script: Each category's angle is its fraction of the total, times 360 degrees. Walk: 14 out of 40 times 360 is 126 degrees.
visual_style: A circle fills slice by slice as angles appear; a final check sums to 360 with a satisfying click.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to draw bar graphs, histograms and pie charts.
